# CV Builder Application - Implementation Plan

## Tech Stack
- **Frontend**: React with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Backend**: Node.js with Express
- **PDF Generation**: jsPDF or react-pdf
- **State Management**: React Context API or Zustand
- **Form Handling**: React Hook Form

## Project Structure
```
cv-builder/
├── client/                 # React frontend
│   ├── src/
│   │   ├── components/    # CV form components, preview, templates
│   │   ├── contexts/      # State management
│   │   ├── types/         # TypeScript interfaces
│   │   ├── utils/         # PDF generation, validation
│   │   └── App.tsx
│   └── package.json
├── server/                # Node.js backend (optional for now)
│   ├── src/
│   │   └── routes/        # API endpoints for future use
│   └── package.json
└── README.md
```

## Core Features to Implement

### 1. CV Data Model
- Personal Information (name, contact, photo)
- Professional Summary
- Work Experience (multiple entries)
- Education (multiple entries)
- Skills (categorized: technical, soft skills)
- Languages
- Certifications
- Projects/Portfolio

### 2. UI Components
- **Form Section**: Multi-step form with validation
  - Personal details form
  - Experience form (add/edit/delete)
  - Education form (add/edit/delete)
  - Skills form (tags/chips input)
  - Additional sections (certifications, languages, projects)
- **Live Preview Panel**: Real-time CV preview
- **Template Selector**: 2-3 professional templates (modern, classic, creative)
- **Export Button**: Download as PDF

### 3. Key Functionality
- Real-time preview as user types
- Local storage to save progress
- Drag-and-drop to reorder sections
- Multiple template options
- PDF export with formatting preservation
- Responsive design (mobile-friendly)

## Implementation Steps

1. **Setup Project**
   - Initialize React app with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS
   - Setup project structure and dependencies
   - Configure build tools

2. **Create Data Models & Context**
   - Define TypeScript interfaces for CV data
   - Setup Context API for state management
   - Implement local storage persistence

3. **Build Form Components**
   - Personal information form
   - Dynamic experience/education forms with add/remove
   - Skills input with tags
   - Form validation with React Hook Form

4. **Implement CV Templates**
   - Create 2-3 responsive CV templates (components)
   - Template selector UI
   - CSS styling with Tailwind

5. **Add Live Preview**
   - Real-time preview component
   - Split-screen layout (form + preview)
   - Mobile-responsive view

6. **PDF Export Feature**
   - Integrate PDF generation library
   - Format CV data for PDF
   - Download functionality

7. **Polish & Testing**
   - Add loading states and error handling
   - Improve UX with transitions/animations
   - Test across browsers
   - Add instructions/help text

## Technologies & Libraries
- `react` + `react-dom`
- `typescript`
- `tailwindcss`
- `react-hook-form` + `zod` (validation)
- `jspdf` + `html2canvas` OR `@react-pdf/renderer`
- `zustand` or Context API
- `lucide-react` (icons)
- `vite` (build tool)

## Future Enhancements (Not in initial scope)
- User authentication
- Backend API for saving CVs
- AI-powered content suggestions
- ATS optimization checker
- Cover letter builder
"}

{"file_path": "README.md", "initial_content": "# CV Builder Application

A modern, feature-rich CV/Resume builder built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Create professional resumes with real-time preview and export to PDF.

![CV Builder](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-18.2.0-blue)
![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-5.2.2-blue)
![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind-3.4.1-blue)

## ✨ Features

### Core Functionality
- **Real-time Preview**: See your CV update instantly as you type
- **Multiple Templates**: Choose from 3 professional templates (Modern, Classic, Creative)
- **PDF Export**: Download your CV as a high-quality PDF
- **Auto-save**: Your data is automatically saved in browser local storage
- **Responsive Design**: Works seamlessly on desktop, tablet, and mobile

### CV Sections
- ✅ Personal Information (with contact details and social links)
- ✅ Professional Summary
- ✅ Work Experience (with CRUD operations)
- ✅ Education (with CRUD operations)
- ✅ Skills (categorized: technical, soft skills, languages, other)
- ✅ Projects (with technologies and links)
- ✅ Certifications (with credentials)
- ✅ Languages (with proficiency levels)

### Templates

#### 1. Modern Template
- Clean contemporary design
- Colorful header with gradient
- Blue accent colors
- Perfect for tech and creative industries

#### 2. Classic Template
- Traditional professional layout
- Serif fonts for formal appearance
- Black and white color scheme
- Ideal for corporate and traditional industries

#### 3. Creative Template
- Two-column layout with sidebar
- Dark sidebar with white content area
- Timeline-style experience section
- Great for designers and creative professionals

## 🚀 Getting Started

### Prerequisites
- Node.js (v16 or higher)
- npm or yarn package manager

### Installation

1. **Install dependencies**
   ```bash
   npm install
   ```

2. **Run the development server**
   ```bash
   npm run dev
   ```

3. **Open your browser**
   Navigate to `http://localhost:3000`

4. **Build for production**
   ```bash
   npm run build
   ```

5. **Preview production build**
   ```bash
   npm run preview
   ```

## 📁 Project Structure

```
cv-builder/
├── src/
│   ├── components/
```

## 🛠️ Technologies Used

### Frontend Framework
- **React 18.2**: Modern UI library with hooks
- **TypeScript 5.2**: Type-safe development
- **Vite**: Fast build tool and dev server

### Styling
- **Tailwind CSS 3.4**: Utility-first CSS framework
- **PostCSS**: CSS processing
- **Custom CSS**: Additional styles and print styles

### State Management
- **React Context API**: Centralized state management
- **Local Storage**: Persistent data storage

### Forms & Validation
- **React Hook Form**: Efficient form handling
- **Zod**: TypeScript-first schema validation

### PDF Generation
- **jsPDF**: PDF document generation
- **html2canvas**: HTML to canvas conversion

### Icons
- **Lucide React**: Beautiful, consistent icons

### Development Tools
- **ESLint**: Code linting
- **TypeScript ESLint**: TypeScript-specific linting rules

## 💡 Usage Guide

### 1. Fill in Personal Information
- Add your name, contact details, and professional summary
- Include links to your website, LinkedIn, and GitHub

### 2. Add Work Experience
- Click "Add Work Experience"
- Fill in company, position, dates, and description
- Edit or delete entries as needed

### 3. Add Education
- Click "Add Education"
- Include institution, degree, field of study, and dates
- Optional: Add GPA

### 4. Add Skills
- Select skill category (Technical, Soft Skills, Languages, Other)
- Choose proficiency level
- Add as many skills as needed

### 5. Optional Sections
- **Projects**: Showcase your work with descriptions and technologies
- **Certifications**: Add professional certifications
- **Languages**: List languages you speak with proficiency levels

### 6. Choose a Template
- Select from Modern, Classic, or Creative templates
- Preview updates in real-time

### 7. Export to PDF
- Click "Export to PDF" button
- Your CV will be downloaded automatically

## 🎨 Customization

### Changing Colors
Edit `tailwind.config.js` to customize the color scheme:

```javascript
theme: {
  extend: {
    colors: {

        500: '#your-color',

}
```

### Adding New Templates
1. Create a new template component in `src/components/templates/`
2. Import and add it to `CVPreview.tsx`
3. Update the `TemplateType` in `src/types/cv.ts`
4. Add the option in `TemplateSelector.tsx`

## 📱 Responsive Design

The application is fully responsive:
- **Desktop**: Split-screen view (form + preview)
- **Tablet**: Collapsible sections
- **Mobile**: Toggle between form and preview views

## 🔒 Privacy & Data

- All data is stored locally in your browser
- No data is sent to any server
- Clear browser data to reset the application
- Export your CV to keep a backup

- PDF export quality depends on browser rendering
- Very long CVs may require manual page break adjustments
- Images/photos are not currently supported
- Internet connection required for Google Fonts
